title: No Weigh Home
alt: A fictional curly-haired adult rooftop hero in plum-purple and lime climbing clothes and round goggles swings from a grappling rope snagged in enormous melted pizza cheese, desperately balancing pizza boxes. Amber and violet city sunset.

title: Jurassic Parking
alt: A gigantic realistic T-rex squeezed into a tiny compact car in a multilevel parking garage, tiny arms trying to reach the parking ticket machine, annoyed queue of cars behind. Rainy teal light and amber headlights; hilarious scale mismatch.

title: The Breadfather
alt: A gravely serious elderly fictional bakery boss with silver curls in a flour-dusted burgundy suit sits in a grand bakery chair cradling a baguette like a treasured pet; breadstick bodyguards and mountains of croissants. Rich chiaroscuro amber, mahogany, dramatic flour in air.

title: Fast & Slightly Curious
alt: Two absurdly serious fictional adult street racers in heavily modified tiny shopping mobility scooters stop nose-to-nose to peer through oversized magnifying glasses at a rubber duck on the asphalt. Neon magenta and cyan wet nighttime parking lot, cinematic tire smoke.

title: Mission: Probably Possible
alt: An original middle-aged secret agent with a bushy mustache in a rumpled teal dinner jacket struggles to step over a single ankle-high velvet rope to reach a vending machine; elaborate climbing harness and spy gear wildly excessive for the task. Dramatic red security beams far in background, cold blue and amber light.

title: Breaking Bread
alt: Two fictional intense artisan bakers, one tall woman with curly dark hair and one stocky young man with red hair, in flour-covered green aprons dramatically pull an enormous sourdough loaf apart in a desert mobile bakery, flour explosion like a thriller climax. Golden desert and turquoise trailer, no drugs.

title: The Average-ers
alt: Four ordinary adult amateur heroes in mismatched homemade capes pose with extreme seriousness around a stubborn pickle jar: plunger wielder, oven-mitt champion, bicycle-helmet guardian, bathrobe leader. Epic storm clouds over a suburban driveway, gold and steel blue light, distinct original costumes.

title: Iron Deficiency Man
alt: A tired fictional adult inventor in clunky handmade copper and mint-green armor slumps on a kitchen stool while a tiny kitchen robot offers an enormous bowl of spinach. Armor powered by a dangling household extension cord, no chest reactor. Dramatic green light and copper reflections.

title: Captain 'Murica
alt: An exuberant fictional mustached backyard barbecue hero wears denim overalls and a striped picnic-tablecloth cape, wielding a circular barbecue grill lid and tongs, riding a lawn mower through flying popcorn and hot-dog buns. Sunset and fireworks, no franchise costume or insignia.

title: Fatman Begins
alt: A cheerful large adult amateur night hero in a quilted aubergine bathrobe cape and colander helmet stands majestically beside a tiny squeaking exercise bike on a rain-soaked rooftop, holding a giant emergency sandwich. Gothic city lights, theatrical purple and gold atmosphere; joke is ridiculous equipment and heroic commitment, no body ridicule or bat symbols.

title: Pretty Good Man
alt: A friendly fictional adult superhero in mustard coveralls and a teal towel cape triumphantly rescues a single grocery bag from a knee-high puddle using a tiny stepping stool, while a bored pigeon watches. Epic sunbeams and billowing cape for a tiny achievement, no chest insignia.

title: Black House Cat
alt: A realistic fluffy black house cat sits regally on a towering throne of scratched cardboard boxes, wearing a tiny violet velvet cape; an army of robot vacuums faces it, scattered cat toys like battle debris. Dramatic violet and amber palace lighting in an ordinary living room. No humanoid franchise costume.

title: Doctor Kinda Weird
alt: An eccentric fictional adult magician with wild silver hair in a teal dressing gown opens a glowing irregular portal with a wooden spoon, only to have hundreds of mismatched socks erupt into his face. Surreal laundromat, violet turquoise and warm golden light, unique magic shapes and clothing.

title: Average-ers: Midgame
alt: Four ordinary amateur heroes in mismatched homemade capes, oven mitts, bathrobe and bicycle helmet pause an epic battle to argue intensely over a tiny tabletop board game at a folding table. Giant looming dust cloud and suburban lawn behind them, one hero holding a miniature plastic pawn triumphantly. Gold and steel blue, no recognizable franchise characters.

title: Pirates of the Cafeteria
alt: A theatrical fictional woman pirate captain with corkscrew red hair and a purple cafeteria-apron coat steers a lunch-tray ship through a tidal wave of spaghetti in a school cafeteria, crew wielding ladles, a seagull stealing fries. Spectacular warm adventure lighting, teal shadows, no familiar movie pirate likeness.

title: That
alt: A ridiculously tiny fuzzy lavender monster with googly eyes dramatically peeks from beneath a plastic mixing bowl in a gloomy kitchen, its shadow on the wall enormous and terrifying but shaped like a rubber duck. Suspenseful fog, emerald moonlight, warm refrigerator glow, playful school-safe horror, no clown or balloons.

title: Room Temperature
alt: An original elegant fantasy queen with short black curls and a knitted coral cardigan tries to conjure a snowstorm but produces one pathetic ice cube into a mug; unimpressed smiling snow-slush creature melting in a potted plant beside her. Cozy beige palace, gentle blue magic and warm amber sun; polished original animated feature look.

title: Down
alt: A whimsical little house is gently sinking into an enormous soft garden mud puddle, held down by ridiculous oversized dumbbells attached with colorful ribbons; an original gray-haired woman in yellow rain boots sits on the roof calmly sipping tea. A deflated single balloon droops from chimney. Warm original animated adventure aesthetic, moss green and sunset coral.

title: Outside In
alt: Five tiny expressive weather creatures made of a rain cloud, sunshine, wind, a snowball, and a leaf tornado desperately cram through a tiny open window into a normal teenager's cozy bedroom, one cloud stuck halfway and raining on the sill. Whimsical polished original animated film, cobalt and coral colors, no familiar emotion characters.

title: Pretty Bad
alt: Three awkward fictional college-age friends in wildly overdressed tuxedos arrive triumphantly at a nearly empty community-center party with one disco ball and one lonely balloon; one carries an enormous bowl of nachos spilling cheese on formal shoes. Comic exaggerated expressions, polished cinematic violet party light, no celebrity likeness.

title: Almost Adults
alt: Five fictional middle-aged friends in business suits and bicycle helmets compete ferociously on tiny children's tricycles at a backyard birthday party, one clutching a juice box like a trophy, sprinkler spraying dramatically. Warm nostalgic summer cinematic photography, hilarious serious faces, no celebrity likeness.

title: The Last Chicken Nugget
alt: A single golden chicken nugget on a cafeteria tray under a dramatic heavenly spotlight while four fictional adult adventurers in improvised kitchen armor desperately reach toward it with forks; monumental blockbuster tension for tiny lunch food, amber and teal cinematic realism.

title: The Dark Snack
alt: An original mysterious night vigilante in a black quilted oven-mitt suit and enormous dark tea-towel cape crouches on a rainy rooftop guarding an illuminated plate of cookies, a raccoon stealing one behind his back. No bat icon or recognizable costume. Blue moonlight and warm cookie glow, photoreal cinematic comedy.

title: Attack of the Group Project
alt: A monstrous avalanche creature made of blank worksheets, tangled cables and glue sticks towers over four fictional college students; three hide behind laptops while one exhausted student holds up the entire collapsing cardboard model. Funny school-safe disaster movie, teal library shadows and amber desk lamps.

title: The WiFi Is Down
alt: A family of fictional adults in a suburban living room dramatically mourns a tiny unplugged router on a velvet cushion like an epic tragedy, one kneeling with a laptop held to the heavens while another discovers the loose cable. Stormy blue and golden light, cinematic hilarious exaggerated expressions. No text on screens.

title: Monday
alt: An exhausted fictional office worker in pajamas and a crooked tie is chased through a kitchen by a stampede of giant ringing alarm clocks, holding an empty coffee mug like a defensive weapon. Surreal action comedy, pink sunrise and cool blue shadows, clocks with blank simple tick marks and no numbers.

title: Dude, Where's My Charger?
alt: Two bewildered fictional college-age roommates in safari gear excavate an enormous tangled mountain of cables in their tiny bedroom; one holds up a banana triumphantly as if it were a priceless discovery. Phone with empty dark screen foreground, amber adventure lighting and turquoise shadows, cinematic comedy.

title: Hallway 9
alt: A terrified fictional adult school janitor faces an impossibly long eerie hallway where nine identical yellow mop buckets slowly advance like sinister monsters; a squeaky rubber duck leads the charge. Fog, green fluorescent light, dramatic orange backlight, funny school-safe horror with no gore and no text.
